plugin.name: SOCOM Fireteam Bravo Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)
skip.description: Skip the opening message-box sequence when supported by this game release. Restart after changing this option.
analog.description: Use the right stick for camera movement and retain native left-stick controls. Restart after changing this option.
loading.description: Temporarily unthrottle loading; restore normal pacing when loading threads exit. Restart after changing this option.
fov.description: Adjust the gameplay camera field of view. 1.0 uses the game's default.
aspect.description: Auto follows PPSSPP's display aspect. Choose a ratio to override it.
hudaspect.description: Auto places HUD groups at the screen edges. Choose a ratio to keep them in a centered box.
hudscale.description: Change the size of gameplay HUD elements around their anchors.
borders.description: Choose which borders preserve the framing of scripted cameras.
language.description: Choose the language used in this Plugins menu.
icons.description: Replace button glyphs in game text. Auto uses Xbox artwork because stock PPSSPP does not report the controller family. PlayStation keeps the original PSP glyphs. Configure controls in PPSSPP. Changes in Plugins apply immediately; file edits require restarting the emulated game.
